fields.title: Shokan: Haji Abdul Gani kara Shū Chōkan e no Yōsei Sho (Letter of Appeal for Copra Compensation)

letter.message: Watashi no kōwan sōko ni hōchi sareta kopra seisanbutsu no yusō chientai ni kan shi, keiyaku ni motozuku songai baishō to yusō no saika o hayaku kyoka shite kudasaru yō ni shinsei itashimasu.

context.purpose: Kopra yusō keiyaku ihō ni kan suru songai baishō to kyūsai no yōsei.

claims.fact: Kojin shokan wa shinseisha ga songai baishō to yusō no kaiko o chokusetsu yōkyū shita koto o shōmei suru.
